id: title:Gilbert09:explain a realtime database url with no database behind it

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a specific error constant and HTTP 404 handling for Firebase Realtime Database ingestion, distinguishing misconfigured URLs from other failures.
review.reason: Adds a new constant REALTIME_DATABASE_NOT_FOUND_ERROR and its documentation, wraps the Firebase request in a try-except to catch HTTP 404 errors and raise FirebaseConfigError, and adds the error to the non-retryable errors dictionary with a helpful user message. This establishes a bounded correctness and reliability improvement for the Firebase warehouse ingestion path.
review.uncertainty: Chunk does not include the definition or implementation of FirebaseConfigError, the FirebaseSource class, or the iter_realtime_database function, making it impossible to verify the complete implementation and behavior of the new error handling and the test. The chunk also does not include the relevant parts of the source.py and firebase.py where the error is raised and handled.

observations.behavior: Adds a new constant REALTIME_DATABASE_NOT_FOUND_ERROR to firebase.py and source.py, and its documentation in settings.py.
observations.code_quote: REALTIME_DATABASE_NOT_FOUND_ERROR: Final[str] = "Firebase has no Realtime Database at the configured URL"
observations.posthog_connection: This constant is used to distinguish a 404 response, indicating a misconfigured URL, from other errors.

observations.behavior: Wraps the request to the Firebase Realtime Database in a try-except block to catch HTTP 404 errors and raise a FirebaseConfigError.
observations.posthog_connection: This allows the system to distinguish between a missing database and other errors, and provide a more helpful error message.

observations.behavior: Adds a new error message for the REALTIME_DATABASE_NOT_FOUND_ERROR to the get_non_retryable_errors dictionary in source.py.
observations.code_quote: REALTIME_DATABASE_NOT_FOUND_ERROR: "No Realtime Database exists at this source's URL. Copy the URL from the Firebase console's Realtime Database page into the source, then re-enable the sync.",
observations.posthog_connection: This provides a helpful error message to the user when the database is not found.
